title: 16705 - 16705/P0321/000801
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) loose
Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28)
technicalNotes:
The Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) is also used as a reference sensor for the Krank Devir Sensörü and correlates with the Eksantrik Konum Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri Bank 1 (G40) and Eksantrik Konum Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri Bank 2 (G163).
When an engine will not start due to mechanical (spark/fuel/compression/timing) related issues it is not uncommon to set a false G28 fault codes due to extended cranking with a no-start condition.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: a VW Golf/Jetta (1J/9M) or Audi A3 (8L) with 1.9l TDI-PD (AXR), Kontrol edin: TPI 2007067 which explains issues with electro magnetic interference. A modification to the wiring will fix this problem, extensive details can be found in the named TPI. Even though this TPI was originally released for VW Golf/Jetta (1J/9M), a customer of ours came across the same issue on an Audi A3 (8L).
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: a 2004 VW Golf, Jetta, or New Beetle with 1.9l TDI-PD (BEW), Kontrol edin: for TSB 2010461 (01-07-45 formerly 97-05-03) or 201463 (01-07-44 formerly 97-05-04) calling for a flash update to the ECU and a secondary ground installation.
General note for any engine type: Kontrol edin:  the wiring to/from the sensor and engine Kontrol Modülü to rule out harness and module damage due to engine oil or coolant from a failed sensor or tensioner. This is an example from a 2012 Tiguan with Coolant in the ECM which resulted in G28 DTCs in addition to intermittent stalling.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
